headerText: Spend your {budget} trait points. Drawbacks pay points back.
incompatibleNote: Clashes with a trait you have already taken.
unaffordableNote: Not enough trait points left for this one.

soldier.name: Old Soldier
soldier.description: Years under arms, a flat voice and a habit that came home with them.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: A brilliant, well-read mind that has spent too long too close to the page.

outlaw.name: Outlaw
outlaw.description: Light fingers, lighter scruples, and a name somebody is still looking for.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Herbs, patience and a refusal to raise a hand to anyone.

mystic.name: Mystic
mystic.description: Born to the work, versed in the still, and careful about omens.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: Built for it, trained for it, and quick to find a reason.

noble.name: Noble Born
noble.description: A house, an inheritance and a manner that opens doors.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.description: Reads the land, follows a track and never loses the way home.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: A steady eye, a fast hand and very little hesitation.

pilgrim.name: Pilgrim
pilgrim.description: A road walked for a creed, and a creed carried quietly.

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: A voice that carries, a taste for pleasure and a way with an audience.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: A nose for a price, an eye on the ladder and a tongue that closes deals.

hexed.name: Hexed
hexed.description: Marked, scarred and out of favour with whoever is meant to be listening.

tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
tinkerer.description: Forge, workbench and a working day nobody else would keep.

beastkin.name: Beastkin
beastkin.description: Raised by something with four legs, and it still shows in the walk.

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.description: Owns three things, speaks to nobody, and wants it kept that way.

nightborn.name: Nightborn
nightborn.description: Something old in the blood, a taste for pain, and scars that came with both.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.description: Sees what has not happened, hears colour, and is believed too late.

firebug.name: Firebug
firebug.description: Lights it, watches it, and is known in three towns for exactly that.

savant.name: Savant
savant.description: Cannot sit still, forgets nothing read, and answers in four languages.

giant.name: Giant
giant.description: Too big for the door, strong enough not to mind, and heard from the next street.

smallfolk.name: Smallfolk
smallfolk.description: Small, folded in ways a body should not fold, and handy with either hand.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.description: Trained to end things quietly, remembered by nobody, moved by nothing.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: Years in a cold cloister, one bowl, and no grudge worth keeping.

silent.name: Silent One
silent.description: Has not spoken in years, sees faces wrong, and wears the reason.

doomsayer.name: Doomsayer
doomsayer.description: Believes in nothing, expects the worst, and is terrified of the end anyway.

caveborn.name: Caveborn
caveborn.description: Born under the rock, white as the stone, and afraid of the dark all the same.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.description: Cannot walk past a table, wins more than they should, and lies about both.

predator.name: Lone Predator
predator.description: It hunts alone, marks a range and does not share it.

packbeast.name: Pack Beast
packbeast.description: It reads a pack the way people read a room, and it has already chosen a leader.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.description: It eats what is left, digs where it must and runs from almost everything.

armoured.name: Armoured Thing
armoured.description: Hide too thick to cut, a bite worth avoiding and a long winter sleep.
